issuing_body: 経済産業省（Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry）
covered_actors: コンテンツ制作に携わる産業界
enforcement_authorities: 内閣府知的財産戦略推進事務局
implementation_notes: This is a non-binding guidebook (ガイドブック) intended to provide practical guidance for content production industries (game, anime, advertising) on appropriate use of generative AI. It explicitly states it does not interpret copyright law or guarantee legality. It is positioned below binding government guidelines (AI事業者ガイドライン) and is intended as a practical companion to those instruments. Content reflects information as of June 2024.
